display.purpose: ARENA ROYALE wordmark, large ink stroke, tilted -2deg.

headline.purpose: Waiting room and other screen titles, large stroke.

title.purpose: Mode, athlete, character and weapon names, medium stroke.

body.purpose: Descriptions and hints; small stroke on color.

label.purpose: Buttons, section titles, tabs, stat names; uppercase, tracked, small stroke.

shadows.name: block-rest
shadows.purpose: Every block at rest; <lip> is the block color's lip shade.

shadows.name: block-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover (pointer) and the selected mode block, with translateY(-2px).

shadows.name: sunk
shadows.purpose: Tracks set into a block: bars, inputs, the switch.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Release of a press (280ms), pops, badge and check entrances.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Arrival drop of trays (620ms, 60ms stagger) and icon wiggles.

motion.name: play-sweep
motion.purpose: Light band across the enabled PLAY block; off under reduced motion.

narrative.overview: Every control is a chunky physical toy block resting on the live match pitch: a thick ink outline, a darker lip inside its bottom edge, a light top bevel and a soft ground shadow. Pressed, a block squashes onto the pitch; released, it bounces back. The top bar is open sky, the side columns are black glass with no blur, and every section is a translucent tray. Type is white Sen 800 with a dark stroke, like a cartoon game's lettering. The family is the cartoon battle-royale lobby (Zombs Royale, Brawl Stars).
keyCharacteristics: A 3px ink outline (2.5px on short landscape) around every block, tray, plate, chip and modal.
An inner bottom lip in the block's darker shade, a top bevel at 30% white and a soft offset ground shadow.
Five toy colors with a meaning each, plus slate for neutral blocks.
Black-glass side panels and translucent trays over a fully visible field.
White lettering with an ink stroke-shadow on every colored surface.
Squash-and-bounce press, a hover lift, a periodic light sweep across PLAY.

rules.name: The Toy Color Rule
rules.body: A color means one thing: orange plays, green co-ops and succeeds, sky is social and info, gold rewards and ranks, red exits and warns, slate is neutral. A new block picks its color by meaning, never by taste.

rules.name: The Lip Rule
rules.body: Every color ships with its lip shade. A block never takes a face color without its matching lip, or it reads flat.

rules.name: The White-On-Color Rule
rules.body: Text on a colored block is white with the ink stroke-shadow, never ink-on-color.

rules.name: The Stroke Rule
rules.body: Lettering on a block carries an ink stroke-shadow sized to the text: small (1px plus a 2px drop) for labels, medium (2px plus a 3px drop) for buttons and titles, large (3px plus a 5px drop and a soft shadow) for the logo and screen titles.

rules.name: The Four-Layer Rule
rules.body: A block is lip plus bevel plus ground offset plus soft drop. Dropping a layer flattens it; a new surface reuses the vocabulary above rather than inventing a shadow.

rules.name: The Squash Rule
rules.body: The press is immediate (0ms): the block moves 3px down, the lip shrinks and the ground shadow nearly disappears. The release springs back over 280ms with a slight overshoot.

dos: Do give every new control the full block: 3px ink outline, matching lip, top bevel, ground shadow, and its three states.
Do pick a block's color by the Toy Color Rule and pair it with its lip.
Do put white type with the ink stroke-shadow on every colored surface.
Do keep side columns black glass (rgba(5,8,10,.56)) with no blur, so the field stays sharp.
Do press at 0ms and release with the spring.
donts: Don't ship a flat colored rectangle or a hairline-ruled row; that is the rejected start-list look.
Don't add backdrop-filter blur over the animated field; it costs frames on phones and hides the pitch.
Don't use ink text on color fills, or a colored glow in place of the ink outline.
Don't animate on mount beyond the one arrival drop, and keep looping motion to the PLAY sweep and the small live cues.
